settings.description: Which `aikit.decision-provider/v1` document AIKit uses when a command takes no explicit `--provider-file` (`aikit decide`). The local Kev service AIKit provisions writes such a document (`aikit decide service provision`). Electing starts nothing: the service lifecycle stays explicit.

effect.summary: `aikit decide status|invoke` without `--provider-file` use the elected document, and refuse when it has changed since it was elected. Nothing is provisioned, started or stopped.
